rationale: The stock gapped down ~9% on earnings and has recovered to 82% of today's range, trading above the 9-EMA and VWAP, suggesting some buying pressure — but the 133 bps bid-ask spread creates significant friction on a ~$87 stock, making clean entries and exits costly. With only 54 minutes to close, the position in the upper range increases reversal risk, and the wide spread combined with a volatile ATR (~$1.05 on 5-minute bars) makes precise risk management difficult. The mechanical edge is insufficient to justify a new position given spread costs and time constraints.
